expression: winsorize(add(add(multiply(3, zscore(add(ts_av_diff(divide(volume, sharesout), 20), ts_av_diff(divide(volume, sharesout), 5)))), zscore(reverse(ts_corr(close, volume, 20)))), zscore(reverse(divide(subtract(close, vwap), vwap)))), std=4)
economic_rationale: Liquidity/attention-axis D0 alpha, economically orthogonal to factor 1 (which is a price-range / intraday-structure axis). Three volume-microstructure terms. PRIMARY (3x weight): multi-horizon ABNORMAL TURNOVER -- ts_av_diff of volume/sharesout over 5d and 20d, i.e. today's share turnover relative to its own recent norm. Abnormal turnover proxies a liquidity/attention shock that shows short-horizon cross-sectional continuation. SECONDARY: reversed price-volume CORRELATION ts_corr(close,volume,20) -- negative/low price-volume co-movement flags distribution (price holding up on falling volume or sliding on rising volume), which mean-reverts. TERTIARY: reversed close-vs-VWAP order-flow imbalance, a small intraday-reversal kicker. Buy stocks with a turnover shock, volume-price divergence and a weak close vs VWAP.
orthogonality_note: Both self-corr vs the ACTIVE submitted pool (0.455) and the PnL correlation vs factor 1 (0.589) are below WorldQuant's 0.7 self-correlation submission bar, so factor 2 is submittable alongside factor 1. The ~0.5-0.6 floor vs factor 1 is structural: at delay=0 abnormal turnover and intraday range expansion are both information-flow/attention proxies that co-move (a pure turnover signal already correlates 0.49 with factor 1); the components needed to clear the D0 SH>2.0 bar raise it to ~0.59. It is a genuinely different economic axis (volume/liquidity vs price-range), not a re-parameterisation of factor 1.
